description: A crumpled piece of paper.  Someone's handwriting covers it — rushed, desperate.
A note scrawled in a hurry.  Reads like someone wanted to leave directions for the next survivor.
A torn piece of paper with sparse, careful handwriting.  Whoever wrote this wanted it to be found.
Записка с координатами и расплывчатыми указаниями.  Тот, кто её писал, явно что-то видел.  Что-то под землёй.
